verdict.rationale: Cal.com lists routing forms as a core feature alongside round-robin and collective scheduling. Its routing-trace API documents how a booking was routed through routing forms, CRM lookups and host selection logic, which confirms that form-driven routing to specific hosts exists. Round-robin settings with host groups, weights and CRM fallback support sending invitees to the right team member. Missing for 10: first-party docs on building routing-form questions and answer-based rules (including qualifying or disqualifying invitees), explicit routing to a team versus an individual, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
